comment: OTDX issuer short-name registry (SPEC 10). Reserved names below; to register an issuer, open a pull request adding an entry.

juno.purpose: Juno region-neutral tag/loc identity (device-derived tag_id / MAC / node); every Juno server emits the same tag URI for the same physical tag

juno-au.purpose: Juno Australasia (AU region) provider / batch-signing identity

juno-cn.purpose: Juno China (CN region) provider / batch-signing identity
